crossRefs.note: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God…
Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and…
A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being…
Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who…
so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

parallels.note: Again he returned, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they didn’t know what to answer him.

translations.web: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
translations.bsb: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
translations.kjv: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
translations.asv: And he came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
